poo_clerk.text: Channel Islands boats from the east pier, Jersey and Guernsey. Between them they run all year round, though the sea decides most days. Bring a coat, a book and something for the gulls.

The Channel Islands are not part of the United Kingdom. They're Crown Dependencies, with their own governments, laws and stamps. You won't need a passport from here, only a good ticket and a strong stomach.

poo_traveller.text: First time? Everyone's first time they get a bit emotional about the cows. The cows are the best bit. Pale gold and big eyes, like a Disney deer who's been told off.
Take a jumper. Both islands gave their names to jumpers, jersey and guernsey. It's cold on the boat.
